public readonly struct PairNode : ISyntaxView<PairNode>
{
    public PairNode(SyntaxTree tree, int index)
    {
        Tree = tree;
        Index = index;
    }

    public SyntaxTree Tree { get; }

    public int Index { get; }

    public TextSpan Span => Tree.Span(Index);

    public bool IsMissing => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Missing) != 0;

    public bool IsSkipped => (Tree.Flags(Index) & NodeFlags.Skipped) != 0;

    public Token Word => new(Tree, Tree.Child(Index, 1));

    public static bool Is(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => index != SyntaxTree.NoNode && tree.Kind(index) == MiniKinds.Pair;

    public static PairNode Create(SyntaxTree tree, int index) => new(tree, index);
}

public abstract class MiniVisitor<TResult>
{
    public virtual TResult Visit(SyntaxTree tree, int node)
    {
        int kind = tree.Kind(node);
        if (SyntaxKinds.ModuleOf(kind) == MiniModule.Instance.Id)
        {
            switch (SyntaxKinds.LocalOf(kind))
            {
                case MiniModule.LPair: return VisitPair(new PairNode(tree, node));
                case MiniModule.LAb: return VisitAb(new AbNode(tree, node));
                case MiniModule.LAc: return VisitAc(new AcNode(tree, node));
                case MiniModule.LIf: return VisitIf(new IfNode(tree, node));
                case MiniModule.LMaybe: return VisitMaybe(new MaybeNode(tree, node));
            }
        }
        return DefaultVisit(tree, node);
    }

    public TResult Visit<TView>(TView view) where TView : struct, ISyntaxView<TView> => Visit(view.Tree, view.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitPair(PairNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitAb(AbNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitAc(AcNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitIf(IfNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    public virtual TResult VisitMaybe(MaybeNode node) => DefaultVisit(node.Tree, node.Index);

    protected virtual TResult DefaultVisit(SyntaxTree tree, int node) => default!;
}
